segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Who places your next wholesale order?

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: For decades, a person. A phone call. A catalog. A webshop.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Next, an agent. But who sets the rules?

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Our answer: open to agents. On Valio Aimo's terms.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: We're The Delusionals. We built two things that work as one.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: First, the Trusted Gateway. An open API for credentialed agents: find products, check price and stock, enforce limits, approve when needed, and record a mock order. Every step logged.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Second, the workspace. The chef describes the need. It sources products, handles exceptions, and asks a human when it matters.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Three scenarios. One set of rules.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: First, a big order: a thousand litres of lactose-free milk, by Monday.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: The agent structures the request and clearly marks its assumptions.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: It checks current price and stock for eleven shortlisted products.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: But the usual Arla has only three hundred and eighty-four litres. The official substitute meets the request, in stock, and costs six hundred euros less than splitting the basket.
segments.chapter: 01 / A stock-out, not a dead end

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Eleven hundred and fifty euros exceeds the agent's five-hundred-euro limit.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: The manager approves the exact basket. Price and stock are checked again. A mock order is recorded, with a full audit trail.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Second, twenty kilos of butter for Friday.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Forty-two euros. Under the limit. The agent commits on its own, and it's still on the record.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: Third: an agent tries to skip the manager, then approve itself. Both requests are refused.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Small orders alone. Humans sign what matters. Never self-approval, stale quotes, or guessing allergens are safe.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: The webshop stays. The buying interface is changing.

segments.speaker: jakub
segments.text: Open to agents.

segments.speaker: krish
segments.text: On Valio Aimo's terms.
